code_repository.label: Source repository
code_repository.execution: disposable local sandbox; no network or secrets by default

open_weights_model.label: Open or downloadable model weights
evidence: model card, architecture, tokenizer, and inference requirements
open_weights_model.execution: local disposable sandbox; reject pickle and remote code by default; never give model access to host secrets

frontier_model_api.label: Frontier or hosted model API
tests: same signed fixtures as local models
frontier_model_api.execution: provider API adapter; store credentials in the user's OS secret store; never include secrets in plans, logs, or prompts

website.label: Website or web application
evidence: network requests in an isolated browser profile
tests: security checks only within written scope
website.execution: isolated ephemeral browser profile; no saved login state; scope allowlist and request-rate limits

mobile_app.label: Mobile application
evidence: manifest, permissions, dependencies, and signing metadata
storage and API behavior in test account
mobile_app.execution: disposable emulator or owner device in test mode; test accounts only; no production account or endpoint

game.label: Game or interactive experience
evidence: controls, state transitions, rules, and level observations
frame timing, memory, and resource profiles
tests: accessibility, input, save, and recovery tests
game.execution: owner-authorized build in disposable local profile; no anti-cheat evasion, DRM circumvention, or live-service abuse

film_or_media.label: Film, audio, or other media
evidence: duration, codec, tracks, and chapter metadata
user-noted visual, audio, and pacing observations
tests: rights review for any generated or shared output
film_or_media.execution: local analysis of authorized files; reports metadata and user notes rather than reproducing protected scenes or soundtracks

general_api.label: API or service contract
evidence: owner-approved base URL and API schema
rate limits, terms, and cost bounds
tests: authentication and authorization using test roles
webhook signatures in a provider sandbox
general_api.execution: mock or staging environment by default; production tests need endpoint-specific approval and a non-destructive allowlist

capability_truth: Profiles define review and test plans. Actual execution requires an installed or configured, isolated adapter and produces evidence only after a run.
